what: Every object-shaped thing a Press cut saw on its tape, sorted by the schema into the data set it belongs to. Written ONLY by the Press (a cut's objects pass); the newsroom scan and the drafting overlay never write here. Readers: the paper (a piece's 'objects on this tape' list), the register's intake (candidates), a Reading's later-sightings, a PG's statements, the tracker, the slate.
rule: Sailor 2026-10-15: every daily/weekly show we scan gets an objects pass — look for objects, then sort them with the schema into any data set we have going. Shows stay readers: a sighting becomes an object only when the record confirms one. A scored cut needs a live object with an open window (PG arcs are standing); a sighting of a Reading whose window has closed files as a later sighting, never a reopening.
kinds: register kinds (ruling · vote · bill · indictment · hearing · suit · tariff/sanction · agreement · appointment · law) plus the Press's own: statement · realization · price · activity
